notes.title: Patch Notes 0.4.8
notes.content:
## Patch Notes 0.4.8  

**Mode Changes:**  
- Ranked/Casual Mode: After clearing 16 rounds, you may now enter Endless Challenge to pursue higher scores!  

**Monster Adjustments:**  
- Forest Sprite: Effect changed to trigger when sold.  

**Operational Optimization:**  
- Added background decal textures and dust particle textures (toggle in Settings).  
- Continue/Settlement buttons at battle end made more prominent.  

**Other Changes:**  
- Fixed incorrect positioning for some synthesized monsters.  
- Fixed occasional unintended discount effect on Bells.  
- Fixed enemy Death Knight occasionally failing to gain Death Knight's effects.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.4.7
notes.content:
## Patch Notes 0.4.7  

**Class Adjustments:**  
- Witch Apprentice: Starting HP adjusted to 30.  

**Mechanic Changes:**  
- Added land tile rotation function - right-click when holding a land tile to rotate.  

**Operational Optimization:**  
- Shows synthesis progress when placing monsters together (even if formula incomplete).  
- Chain-triggered animations during Shop Phase gradually accelerate.  
- Added aura effects for monsters with unactivated On-summon abilities.  

**Other Changes:**  
- Fixed bug where revived monsters had full HP.  
- Fixed incorrect model position for enemy Undead Overseer.  
- Fixed Skeleton Warrior's On-summon buff failure when swapping positions with Undead-type monsters.  
- Fixed skill activation failure for enemy Red Fox and Cunning Red Fox.  
- Fixed occasional matchmaking failures (if issue persists post-update, please contact us).

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.4.6
notes.content:
## Patch Notes 0.4.6  

**Class Adjustments:**  
- Miao Nubis: Now starts with an additional land tile - "Arid Land".  

**Monster Adjustments:**  
- Frenzied Boar: Rarity reduced by 1 tier.  
- Necromancer: Damage adjusted to 2.  
- Archlich: Damage adjusted to 4.  
- Strange Egg: Selected monsters are now guaranteed to be different.  

**Relic Adjustments:**  
- Battle Gauntlet: Now grants Taunt to a random monster at the bottom of the battlefield.  

**Mechanic Changes:**  
- Refresh Bell: Cost increases by 1 every 5 refreshes per round.  
- Relic Selection: Now offers 4 options to choose from.  
- Casual Mode: All classes start with +5 HP.  
- Ranked Mode: Gain 5 HP when choosing to continue at round 12.  

**Operational Optimization:**  
- Leaderboard now displays character silhouettes on the left side.  
- Optimized effect trigger speed for Celestial Feather Dragon and Brown Drake.  

**Other Changes:**  
- Relic: Eternal Torch temporarily removed (enemy's Eternal Torch effects disabled) - will return in official release.  
- Fixed Crab Soldier's inability to target monsters with Revival.  
- Fixed Colorful Scale miscounting Yellow Drake and its morphs as different monsters.  
- Fixed occasional failure of Fractured Land's shatter effect.  
- Fixed monster selection still being possible while settings menu is open.  
- Fixed incorrect animation when I.O. gains attributes.  
- Fixed occasional missing animations.  
- Fixed position offset of monster ATK/HP values on battlefield.

notes.title: New Characters! Patch Notes 0.4.5
notes.content:
## Patch Notes 0.4.5  

**New Class:**  
- Miao Nubis: Gains 1 gold whenever 3 allied monsters with Deathrattle die.  

**New Monsters:**  
- Cube Slime : On summon: Place a random Land tile into your Reserve Area.  

**New Land Tiles:**  
- Fractured Land : Shatters after entering the battlefield!  

**Operational Optimization:**  
- Added connection hints for synthesizable monsters.  
- Merchant's right panel now displays shop pool probabilities and race info.  
- Enhanced visual feedback when lacking gold for purchases.  
- Improved round counter visibility.  
- Streamlined character unlock interface.  
- Added race selection prompts on character selection screen.  

**Other Changes:**  
- Relic: Eternal Torch temporarily removed (will return in official release).  
- Fixed bug where Undead Overseer's revival occasionally failed to trigger.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.4.3
notes.content:
## Patch Notes 0.4.3  

**Relic Adjustments:**  
- Smooth Stone : Added combo effect detection  
- Extremely Smooth Stone : Added combo effect detection  
- Enchanted Bell : Added combo effect  
- Demon Blood : Effect changed to: HP becomes 1, all monster purchases are discounted  
- Immortal Guardian : Enhanced visual feedback - affected monsters now display effects more clearly  

**Operational Optimization:**  
- Added HP bars during combat (showing total HP of monsters)  
- Improved monster manipulation responsiveness on the battlefield  
- Smoother background gradient transitions during battles  
- Added tier display on character selection interface in Ranked Mode  

**Other Updates:**  
- Fixed bug where enemy Undead-type monsters couldn't gain effects from Dread Mummy and similar monsters  
- Fixed bug where enemy Death Knight couldn't gain Death Knight's effects  
- Fixed occasional failure in leaderboard data retrieval  
- Fixed occasional missing effect descriptions for relics in the Codex  
- Fixed occasional offline mode functionality issues
